title: Script & Analysis External Prompt Request V3
description: Request used to build the external ChatGPT prompt for one combined Script and Script Analysis response. The backend loads the currently selected Topic Idea from the project; topic content must not be supplied here. The optional selected_topic_idea_id is only an optimistic stale-state check.

target_duration_minutes.description: Requested narration runtime. Each Script section chooses its own planned_narration_wpm inside user_input.narration_wpm; backend derives whole-video runtime diagnostics from those section plans.

pov_style.description: User-supplied point of view and narration style for the Script that ChatGPT writes before analyzing it.

avoid.description: User-supplied Script content or treatment to avoid. This is separate from Topic Ideas avoid_topics.

section_count_mode.description: Controls section planning. 'llm_decides' lets ChatGPT choose the section count and roles inside backend safety bounds; 'backend_plan' requires the exact backend section plan.

pacing_mode.description: Per-video visual pacing mode. Topic Ideas may recommend a default, but the user explicitly chooses the mode for this Script build.

narration_wpm.description: Inclusive narration WPM range selected in the Script & Analysis build form. The LLM must choose an exact planned_narration_wpm inside this range for every section.

selected_topic_idea_id.description: Optional optimistic stale-state check. If provided and differs from the persisted selection, returns 409 TOPIC_IDEA_MISMATCH. Backend always uses the persisted selection regardless.
